translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: “Wena thuolo matin mondi to abiro nyisi
ni nitie mathoth manyalo wacho kuom Nyasaye.
Ngʼeyo ma an-go agolo kuma bor;
kendo koro adwaro nyiso kaka Jachwechna timo gik makare.
Bed kingʼeyo ni wechena ok gin miriambo;
ngʼeni ngʼama ongʼeyo gik moko malongʼo chuth ema ni kodi.
“Nyasaye nyalo duto, to kata kamano ok ochayo ji;
onyalo duto kendo chenro mage ok lokre.
Ok owe joricho kangima,
to omiyo joma ithiro ratiro margi.
Ok ogol wangʼe oko kuom joma kare;
oketogi e loch kaachiel gi ruodhi kendo otingʼogi malo nyaka chiengʼ.
Ka otwe ji gi nyiroro,
kendo ka oridgi matek gi tonde mag masiche,
to onyisogi gik magisetimo;
kendo ni giseketho ka ok gidewo.
Omiyo giwinje korieyogi
kendo ochikogi ni gilokre giwe timbegi maricho.
Ka giwinjo wachne mi gitiyone,
to gibiro dak e mwandu ndalogi mabiro,
kendo gibiro dak ka gin gi gimoro amora e higni mabiro.
To ka gitamore winje,
to ligangla biro tiekogi,
kendo gibiro tho ka gionge rieko.
“Joma okia Nyasaye chunygi opongʼ gi mirima
ma kata ka okumgi to ok giywagre mondo oresgi.
Omiyo githo ka kapod gitindo
ka ngima marach otieko tekregi.
To joma ni e chandruok oreso e chandruokgi;
owuoyo kodgi e kinde ma gin gi chandruok.
“Ogoli e masiche kendo oteri kama onge chandruok
mondo omiyi kwe gi chiemo mogundho.
Sani to koro eri iyudo kum maromre gi joricho;
nimar kum kod adiera oketi diere.
Bed motangʼ kik ngʼato wuondi gi mwandu,
kendo kik iyie ngʼato omiyi asoya mathoth mi iwe Nyasaye.
Koso iparo ni mwanduni mathoth
kata nyagruok minyagori,
gi tekri iwuon nyalo siri mi goli e chandruok?
Kik igomb mondo piny oyusi,
mondo otim timbe mahundu.
Tangʼ mondo chandruok
kik dwoki e richo.
“Parie kaka teko Nyasaye duongʼ
en e japuonj maberie moloyo?
En ngʼa manyalo nyiso Nyasaye yore monego oluw,
kata manyalo kwere ni, ‘Isetimo marach’?
Kik wiyi wil mak ipako tijene
ma gin tijene ma ji osepako gi wer.
Ji duto modak e piny osenene
adier gisenene gi kuma bor.
Mano kaka Nyasaye duongʼ,
adier oduongʼ mokalo ngʼeyo kendo kata hike ok wanyal kwano.
“Ochoko ngʼich mar pi kogolo ewi pige,
kendo olokogi koth mi gichak gichue gipongʼ aore;
omiyo koth chue
ne ji koa e boche polo.
En ngʼa mongʼeyo kaka boche polo ringo,
kata kaka polo mor?
Neye kaka omiyo mil polo menyo kor polo duto,
ka chuny nam to dongʼ kotimo mudho.
Kamano e kaka orito ogendini
kendo omiyogi chiemo mogundho.
Omako mil polo gi lwete
kendo otimogo gima odwaro.
Mor polo miyo wangʼeyo ni koth maduongʼ chiegni chue,
kendo koda ka jamni ongʼeyo ni koth ma kamano biro chue.
